title: ESM static build should target Chrome 100 with Lightning CSS
body:
<!-- Please provide the issue number here if any -->

## Changelog Entry

<!-- Please paste your new entry from CHANGELOG.MD here. Entry is not required for work only related to development purposes. -->

### Added

- (Experimental) Added support for importing via `<script type="module">`, by [@compulim](https://github.com/compulim) in PR [#5592](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5592)
   - Added target to Chrome 100 and re-enable Lightning CSS for ESM builds, by [@compulim](https://github.com/compulim) in PR [#5602](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5602)

## Description

<!-- Please discuss the changes you have worked on. What do the changes do; why is this PR needed? -->

ESM static builds did not specify target of Chrome 100, thus, tests are not snapshotting Fluent theme properly as Chrome 110 does not support nested CSS.

Also re-enabled Lightning CSS.

Note: Chrome 100 is primarily for our WebDriver, which run Chrome 110. Production build should only target minus 2 major versions.

## Specific Changes

<!-- Please list the changes in a concise manner. -->

- Updated `esbuild.static.mjs` for Lightning CSS and targeting
- Moved Lightning CSS unplugin to `/esbuildPlugins.mjs` for reusability
